name: Moshi Moshi Retail Corporation Public Company Limited
summary: Moshi Moshi Retail Corporation Public Company Limited, a Thai enterprise, specializes in the retail and wholesale distribution of a wide array of lifestyle merchandise. Its expansive inventory encompasses diverse categories, including home essentials, stationery, fashion apparel, personal care products, electronic gadgets, children's toys, confectionery, and health-related items. Specific examples from their extensive range include everything from rugs, plush toys, and t-shirts to Bluetooth speakers, beauty accessories, and COVID-19 testing kits. Additionally, the company makes its products available through an online sales platform. Founded in 2000, the firm is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
